description: A shell script for managing git tags, specifically for tagging the latest release based on semantic versioning, with functions for git operations, version parsing, and comparison.

methods.name: run_git_tag
methods.description: Tags the current commit as 'latest' if conditions are met.

methods.name: git_show_ref
methods.description: Retrieves the reference for a given git tag, with mock behavior for testing.

methods.name: get_latest_tag_list
methods.description: Fetches the list of latest tags, with mock behavior for testing.

methods.name: split_string
methods.description: Splits a version string into components based on a delimiter.
